response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer, but the profile does not match the core mandatory requirements. Hands-on C++ experience is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments (2014–2015) and a university thesis project, far short of the 5–10 years of professional C++ on Windows required. The career is overwhelmingly web/backend focused (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang), with Linux/cloud rather than Windows platforms, and no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle depth. Financial domain exposure is limited to RIDE Capital (retail investment/fintech), not fixed income, derivatives, capital markets, or investment banking. Strong engineering fundamentals and communication skills are evident, but the gap on the non-negotiable technical and domain criteria is too large for this consulting engagement.
strengths: Broad, deep polyglot engineering background with strong testing/TDD and CI/CD discipline
Proven low-latency, high-throughput systems work (millions of requests/sec at Sociomantic)
Excellent communication evidenced by conference talks, workshops, and courses taught
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ experience versus the required 5–10 years
No fixed income, derivatives, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience
No demonstrated Windows platform development or SQL Server/Oracle expertise

key_factors.factor: Windows platform and SQL Server/Oracle skills
